# Deposition of Dev Patel (10/22/2026): page-line digest by topic (T. Novak, 11/3, for M. Desai)
CONFIDENTIAL under Dkt. 28. Signature reserved; errata due 12/2.

## Background
- 12:3-10: Plant Engineering Manager at Elk Grove Village since 2019.
